name: Brief regen cron — kognai-brief-regen PM2 entry
goal: Add kognai-brief-regen PM2 cron to ecosystem.config.js. Fires at 06:45 UTC daily, runs: python3 scripts/generate-daily-brief.py. This ensures workspace/sprint-brief.md is always regenerated before the daily digest (07:00), so every new Claude Code session starts with a fresh, accurate brief — no need to read raw MEMORY.md or progress.md. Saves ~3K tokens per session. Script already exists. This is a 1-entry ecosystem.config.js edit.
rationale: sprint-brief.md is the primary context for every session. Currently it only regenerates when manually triggered. Adding a 06:45 cron means every morning session starts with an accurate brief reflecting the latest sprint history, env status, and blockers — reducing session startup overhead and avoiding stale-brief mistakes.
